summary: Selects Gemini reasoning depth using named levels. Higher levels improve difficult multi-step work but increase latency and billed output tokens. The supported levels and default vary by model, so the synchronized catalog supplies a separate option matrix for each compatibility set.
combines: Gemini 3.7 Flash supports low, medium and high and defaults to medium.
Gemini 3.6 Flash and Gemini 3.5 Flash support minimal, low, medium and high and default to medium.
Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite supports the same four levels and defaults to minimal.
Do not combine with thinkingBudget; the two controls belong to different model generations.
note: Exposed only on Gemini 3.x models, using each model's documented level set and default. Gemini 2.5 keeps provider-managed budget thinking.
